regions.merged_text: a decided heightening of his faith and confidence in the super- natural and in the divine providence of Heaven? In His merciful, unfathomable wisdom and goodness, Almighty God left that little relic with you as long as you needed it for just that kind of inspiration. And when it had served its purpose and Mercy Hall was well started, He lifted it away from you, (how, is quite secondary. ) lest curiosity and consequent want of appre- ciation and of reverence mar the delicacy and the supernatural fragrance of that -- ? -- His own little blue-print? . · · · Aye! Glory be to God and blessed be His holy Name in all His designs! and in these designs; not merely including, but positively stressing just the knocks and the humiliations we meet with and the crisis after crisis He sometimes permits even while by His grace He fortifies us to profit by them all more than by anything else, save by the actual reception of the very Sacraments themselves.
